title: Ministral 3 quality-per-byte frontier
hypothesis: The Apache-2.0 Ministral 3 3B Instruct model can clear the unchanged 75% task floor and cloud SLOs in a roughly 2.1 GB package, while Q4_0 exposes a KleidiAI-accelerated performance option and Q4_K_M provides a quality-oriented anchor.
selection_basis: Mistral's official immutable model card reports 0.830 MATH Maj@1 for the 3B instruct model, describes it as edge-optimized with strong system-prompt and JSON adherence, and recommends temperature below 0.1 for production. The source and both evaluated GGUF derivatives are Apache-2.0. Published aggregate scores select the candidate only and are not submission evidence.
controlled_difference: Both candidates derive from the same pinned source model and quantization producer and use the same semantic instruction, system-role prompt mapping, runtime, host, tasks, greedy decoding, threads, and context. GGUF weight quantization is the only candidate-level difference.

quality.prediction_parser: first standalone uppercase A-D after case folding
